source.notes: Values are ANEEL tariffs before taxes, public lighting fee and tariff flag surcharges. ANEEL does not map distributors to states in this dataset. With-taxes figures: Project-standard assumption, not published by ANEEL: ICMS 18% and PIS/COFINS 3.65%, charged on the gross amount (por dentro): tariff / (1 - 0.18 - 0.0365). Excludes the public lighting fee and tariff flag surcharges.
